cases.requirements: Diagnose a short real planning and simulation chain. Retain failed and incomplete steps; measure cost and latency without claiming narrative quality, task completion or improvement from one trial.

pass_conditions: Physical requests and failures have explicit module, timing and usage provenance.
fail_conditions: Missing attribution is presented as measured module timing or a failed run is hidden.
allowed_variants: The simulation may be incomplete or hit its hard budget; report this without inventing an ending.
gold.contrast_example: A fast failed run must not be described as an improvement in completed-task latency.
gold.origin: Diagnostic variant of the existing short guild scenario, not an approved behavior Gold Case.
